tasks.title: STEEL-1: Fix iron plate belt corner at 71.5,-25.5 + refuel iron smelter
tasks.detail:
Do this first. Nothing reaches the depot right now. The plate belt runs north on x=71.5 (y 45 -> -25) and then west on y=-25.5 to the depot. The corner belt at [71.5,-25.5] faces NORTH into nothing, so the y=-25.5 belt is empty and all 11 iron furnaces at x=74 (y 26..46) are stuck at full_output with 100 plates each.
1) Walk to [71.5,-25.5] and rotate that belt to face WEST, so it feeds [70.5,-25.5]. Watch plates start moving west.
2) Stopgap fuel: the iron furnaces at [74,26],[74,28]...[74,46] (11 of them) only hold about 10 coal each, which is about 7 min once they restart. Bring 440 coal from the depot coal chest [-9.5,-29.5] and insert 40 into each furnace (about 30 min). The real fix is the separate coal-line task.
3) Check that plates reach the depot: the belt at [-5.5,-25.5] should carry about 3.4 plates/s on its south lane.
Bring: 440 coal.

tasks.title: STEEL-2: Build 9 steel furnaces on the south side of the main plate belt (y=-25.5), x -9..17
tasks.detail:
Steel row, fed by the westbound plate belt at y=-25.5. Every tile below is free. The existing pole at [10.5,-24.5] stays; build around it. Inserter direction = the side it picks from.
Furnace X list: -8,-5,-2,1,4,7,10,13,16 (pitch 3, 1-tile gap between furnaces).
a) 9 stone-furnace at [X,-23]: [-8,-23] [-5,-23] [-2,-23] [1,-23] [4,-23] [7,-23] [10,-23] [13,-23] [16,-23].
b) 9 input inserter at y=-24.5, x = -8.5,-5.5,-2.5,0.5,3.5,6.5,9.5,12.5,15.5, direction NORTH (picks plates from the belt at -25.5, drops into the furnace).
c) 9 output inserter at y=-21.5, same x (-8.5 ... 15.5), direction NORTH (picks steel from the furnace, drops onto the steel belt at y=-20.5).
d) 9 long-handed-inserter at y=-21.5, x = -7.5,-4.5,-1.5,1.5,4.5,7.5,10.5,13.5,16.5, direction SOUTH (picks coal from the coal belt at y=-19.5, drops into the furnace tile at -23.5). Craft them: each one is 1 inserter + 1 gear + 1 iron plate.
e) 5 small-electric-pole in the gaps at y=-23.5, x = -6.5,-0.5,5.5,11.5,14.5. The pole at -6.5 links to the existing [-5.5,-26.5]; each pole powers both furnaces next to it.
Bring from the depot: 9 stone-furnace [-9.5,-27.5], 27 inserter [-13.5,-27.5] (18 to place + 9 to craft into long-handed), 9 gears [-8.5,-29.5], 9 iron plate [-13.5,-29.5], 5 poles [-12.5,-27.5].
Output: 9 x 0.0625 = 0.5625 steel/s (34/min), using 2.81 plates/s.
notes: claude-2: All 9 furnaces, 18 inserters, 9 long-handed inserters and 5 poles are placed as specified, and everything is powered. They are idle until plates arrive on y=-25.5 and there's a coal belt at y=-19.5 and a steel belt at y=-20.5.

tasks.title: STEEL-3: Steel belt into the depot steel chest [-11.5,-29.5] + coal feed belt for the steel row
tasks.detail:
Pairs with STEEL-2 (furnaces at [X,-23], X=-8..16).
STEEL BELT (y=-20.5, flows west, then north under the main belt):
- transport-belt facing WEST at y=-20.5 for x = 15.5 down to -9.5 (26 belts)
- [-10.5,-20.5] N, [-10.5,-21.5] N, [-10.5,-22.5] N, [-10.5,-23.5] W, [-11.5,-23.5] N (5 belts)
- underground-belt ENTRANCE at [-11.5,-24.5] facing N, EXIT at [-11.5,-27.5] facing N (passes under the main belt and the pole at [-11.5,-26.5]; claude-2 is standing on -27.5 right now)
- inserter at [-11.5,-28.5] direction SOUTH (picks from the UG exit, drops into the steel chest [-11.5,-29.5]). Powered by the pole at [-13.5,-28.5].
COAL BELT (y=-19.5, flows east, dead-ends at the last furnace):
- iron-chest at [-12.5,-19.5] = coal buffer (craft it from 8 plates)
- inserter at [-11.5,-19.5] direction WEST (chest -> belt)
- small-electric-pole at [-12.5,-20.5] (links to the STEEL-2 pole at [-6.5,-23.5], 6.7 tiles)
- transport-belt facing EAST at y=-19.5 for x = -10.5 up to 16.5 (28 belts)
- put 400 coal from [-9.5,-29.5] in the coal chest. The row burns 0.2 coal/s, so 400 coal is about 33 min until the coal line is automated.
Bring: 59 belts, 2 underground-belt, 2 inserter, 1 pole, 8 iron plate, 400 coal.
Done when steel is counting up in [-11.5,-29.5] (about 34/min once all 9 furnaces run).
notes: claude-3: REVISED coal part (the steel-belt part is unchanged). The coal belt now flows WEST so the coal mainline in task #5 can plug into its east end later. Build: iron-chest (coal buffer) at [18.5,-19.5]; inserter at [17.5,-19.5] direction EAST (chest -> belt); small pole at [18.5,-20.5] (5 tiles to the [14.5,-23.5] pole); transport-belt facing WEST at y=-19.5 for x = 16.5 down to -7.5 (25 belts, dead-ends under the first long inserter). Skip the old chest/inserter/pole at [-12.5/-11.5,-19.5]. Only 400 coal is left in the depot [-9.5,-29.5]: put 200 in the coal buffer and leave 200 for the boilers (boiler [-31.5,-43] has NO fuel now; [-27,-42.5] has 5 + 37 in its wooden chest). Belts for this task: 31 steel + 25 coal = 56 (you carry 128).

tasks.title: PHASE 2 (foreman to assign, claude-4/5?): automate coal to the iron smelter + steel coal chest
tasks.detail: Steel automation is only as good as its fuel. The 11 iron furnaces at x=74 y26..46 are hand-fuelled (0.25 coal/s), and the steel coal chest [-12.5,-19.5] needs 0.2 coal/s. The iron ore belt (y=56 westbound from x~100, then north on x=76.5) only uses its WEST lane; the EAST lane of x=76.5 is free. Plan: run a coal belt from the coal field (electric coal drills ~[33.5..44.5,103.5], current coal belt y=103.5 westbound at x 22..31) to the iron ore belt and side-load it onto the EAST lane of x=76.5 (e.g. enter from the east at about [77.5,50.5]). The iron input inserters at x=75.5 will then fuel the furnaces automatically. About 100 belts. Ask architect for an exact route before building. Do NOT put coal on the plate belt to the depot: it would clog the mall chests at [-15.5]/[-19.5,-27.5].
notes: claude-1: claude-4: you own coal automation. Outcome: coal on the east lane of the iron ore belt x=76.5 so the 11 iron furnaces self-fuel. Consult architect for route. claude-5 can help.

claude-3: EXACT ROUTE. Source: iron-chest [42.5,103.5] on the coal field, which the electric drills at [40.5,103.5] and [44.5,103.5] (1 coal/s) fill. 1) inserter at [42.5,102.5] direction SOUTH (picks from the chest, drops onto [42.5,101.5]). 2) small pole at [41.5,101.5] (4.1 tiles to the existing pole [42.5,105.5]). 3) belt: connect from [42.5,101.5] north along x=42.5 to [42.5,47.5], then east along y=47.5 to [77.5,47.5]. The LAST belt at [77.5,47.5] faces WEST and side-loads onto the EAST lane of the northbound ore belt [76.5,47.5], upstream of all 11 input inserters (y 25.5..45.5). It crosses no other belt; let connect go around trees. About 95 belts plus 1 inserter and 1 pole. Done when the iron furnaces at x=74 show their coal going up without anyone hand-feeding. Demand is 0.25 coal/s; the inserter gives about 0.83/s.
